No longer goes on cooldown when it doesn't trigger
Now grants +1 Move Speed during the active
Initial grace period increased from 0.2s to 0.3s
Previous recorded cooldown change: 23s to 21s, July 11th, 2024.
Added 0.2s grace period where the reload start does not count any button presses
Active fire rate increased from 18% to 24%
Previous recorded cooldown change: 25s to 23s, July 4th, 2024.
Active fire rate bonus increased from 15% to 18%
Timing window to click increased from 0.2s to 0.3s
Active Bullet Lifesteal increased from 30% to 40%
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.
